messages:
Maya: heads up — enabled FP8 attention kernels in shadow on h100 + l40s. quick smoke showed a small but consistent quality delta on long-prefix summarization suite.
Jon: saw it too. drop shows up when prefix > ~1200 tokens.
Sam: what metric are we seeing?
perf-bot: shadow-run summary: summarization-suite-v2 -> ROUGE-L -2.6% (p<0.01), avg logit magnitude down ~4%.
Lee: any correlation with kv cache alignment or tiling?
Maya: early signal points to kv alignment + accumulation scaling. FP8 matmul seems to underflow on later steps for some attention blocks.
Anya: can you paste repro snippet?
Maya: sure — quick local repro we used:
```bash
python tools/repro_fp8.py --model orion-7b --device l40s --prefix-file tests/long_prompt_1k.txt --quant fp8 --seed 42
```
Maya: output excerpt: 
```
INFO:step=1800 block=attn_kv scale_max=1.2e-3 scale_min=8.5e-7 mean_logit=-2.3 
WARNING:reduced_entropy at step 1812 -> 0.42 (baseline 0.47)
```
Jon: that min scale is worrying. looks like per-tensor scale collapse in later tiles.
Sam: could be due to accumulation precision in tiled matmul + rotary scaling. Any L2 norm diffs?
perf-bot: metric: mean-weighted-l2-diff across activations = 0.0038 vs baseline 0.0011 (on long prefixes).
Lee: immediate mitigation options: 1) per-layer fallback to fp16 for attention matmul, 2) apply scalar-rescale pass before softmax, 3) clip per-channel scales.
Anya: ops question — can we do a canary split routing long-prefix requests to fp16 variant while keeping short ones on fp8?
deploy-bot: canary update: routing-policy set for model/orion-7b -> 1% long-prefix fp16, 99% fp8 shadow (applied).
Maya: will add a runtime heuristic: if kv_cache_len > 1024 then fall back to fp16 for attn matmuls. quick patch PR incoming.
Sam: also suggest adding a microrepro that compares logits and token-level entropy to catch this earlier in future rollouts.
Maya: agreed. plan: microrepro + new smoke that runs long prefix suite in shadow every deploy.
Jon: long-term: investigate quantization-aware reshaping so tiling boundaries don't create scale collapse. maybe per-channel AWQ-style scales for KV.
Lee: add observability: emit per-step scale_max/scale_min histogram to console and trace. create alert if scale_min < 1e-6 or scale_range > 1e4.
Anya: will add alert and a dashboard tile for "FP8 scale health".
Sam: what's impact on perf if we fallback for long prefixes?
perf-bot: estimate: fp16 fallback on attn for prefixes >1k -> latency +6-8% p99, cost +9% token.
Maya: acceptable for now given quality delta. prioritize correctness.
Lee: can we instead try hybrid: keep kv matmul fp8 but force LayerNorm/softmax compute to fp16? might be cheaper than full matmul fallback.
Jon: worth exploring — softmax numeric stability is sensitive. converting pre-softmax logits to fp16 could recover entropy.
Maya: I'll prototype both: (A) attn matmul -> fp16, (B) only pre-softmax cast to fp16 + scalar rescale.
Sam: add eval scripts to compare exact-match logits and ROUGE on the canary traffic. example command: 
```bash
./tools/eval_compare.sh --model orion-7b --variants fp8,fp16 --prompt tests/long_summ_prompts.txt --metrics rouge,entropy,logit_diff --out /tmp/fp8_bakeoff.json
```
Maya: tagging oncall @Anya — if we see regression >2% ROUGE-L in prod canary, automatic rollback to fp16.
Anya: noted. I'll prepare rollback playbook and runbook steps.
Lee: also add a reproducible unit test in runtime tests that toggles tiling offsets to try to trigger scale collapse deterministically.
Maya: ok next steps: PR with runtime heuristic + microrepro, perf team to validate perf delta, ops to configure alerts + rollback.
Sam: thanks. feel free to @me on the PR for eval harness. :thumbsup:
Maya: will post PR link shortly. thanks all :)
